summary.prose: Build a reviewed, file-level ingestion path for the design corpus, retaining pinned source identities and complete attribution through packaged outputs. Keep eligibility, lineage and notice checks pure, with local Git acquisition isolated behind a bounded binary reader. Independently validate the assembled candidate before issuing its eligibility assessment; editorial coverage and publication remain downstream.

tasks.title: Define strict source contracts and validation primitives
tasks.summary: Add proposed sources/contracts.ts and validation-primitives.ts plus a pure sources entry; exact sc3 TypeBox/AJV schemas, internal reviewed profiles and lineage envelopes, deterministic source identity from canonical repository URL/full revision/path tuple.
acceptanceChecks: Exact SourceFile/SourceManifest/ImportReport shapes; no coercion, defaults or unknown fields; unique source IDs, full 40/64 lower-hex commits, SHA256 digests and portable evidence refs.
Internal profiles carry policy version, explicit categories, reviewed exact-file/evidence digests, reviewer and obligation decisions; never accept caller eligibility as authorization.
Reuse exported isPortablePath and canonical helpers; local NFC/lowercase and UTC timestamp checks match S001 public behavior for adversarial paths/dates without new S001 exports.

tests.name: source-schema preserves exact sc3 shapes and rejects invalid identities and fields
validation-parity matches S001 path collision and UTC timestamp behavior

tasks.title: Implement reviewed file eligibility and dependency closure
tasks.summary: Add proposed sources/policy.ts and eligibility.ts pure staging policy over acquired bytes and reviewed descriptors.
acceptanceChecks: Only exact allowlisted repository/revision/path/digest profiles with explicit reviewed license/evidence obligations admit bytes; MIT/Apache-2.0/CC0 labels alone never authorize admission; fonts and compound expressions require explicit reviewed decisions.

Unknown/conflicting/absent terms unresolved; disallowed paths/repositories excluded; stale successfully acquired file/evidence digests unresolved for affected paths and all requested dependents while independent eligible files remain admitted.

Resolve bounded evidence closure deterministically; malformed input, duplicate/colliding identities or limit excess fail request; no unresolved/excluded bytes in staged payload, no provider/network and no implicit clock.

tests.name: mixed-eligibility admits only reviewed exact-file profiles with complete evidence
mixed-eligibility propagates stale evidence without rejecting independent eligible files
mixed-eligibility requires explicit font and compound-license decisions

tasks.title: Read exact local Git objects without text conversion
tasks.summary: Add proposed sources/git-reader.ts separate I/O entry and injectable binary process seam; local repository only, pinned full commit and exact tree/blob membership.
acceptanceChecks: Read raw binary blob bytes from verified commit objects despite dirty worktree/branch movement; verify full commit type and object framing; reject missing revision/path or inconsistent acquisition as request-level failure with no admitted result.
Validate all selected paths before process I/O; selected percent/colon/traversal/duplicate/case-NFC collisions fail; unselected repository paths do not affect results.

Use shell:false argv with literal paths, disable replacement objects/lazy fetching/config-driven commands and filters; never clone/fetch/checkout or execute source; reject selected symlinks/submodules, identify LFS as unresolved unsupported material.

tests.name: pinned-reader preserves binary commit bytes despite worktree and branch changes
pinned-reader rejects missing commits paths and corrupt object framing
reader-safety rejects selected unsafe paths before I/O and ignores unselected paths
reader-safety rejects symlinks and submodules and leaves LFS unresolved
reader-safety prevents replacement filters lazy fetch and config-driven commands

tasks.title: Enforce reader resource limits and failure cleanup
tasks.summary: Complete binary reader bounds and lifecycle in proposed sources/git-reader.ts with controlled process fixtures.
acceptanceChecks: Apply <=10000 files and <=64MiB aggregate acquired bytes including evidence, incremental bounded stdout/stderr and <=30-second child timeout; reject excess before retaining unbounded output, never silently truncate.
Abort/cancel, malformed/truncated stream, spawn/exit failure and missing Git return sanitized request failures with no admitted bytes; terminate children and release handles/buffers.
Tests exercise exact boundary and over-limit behavior without huge allocations or sleeps using injected limits/process seam; local integration demonstrates no network/config-command/filter execution.

Count requested files and their transitive license/notice evidence together within the request-wide budget, deduplicating shared acquired objects deliberately; shared evidence cannot bypass count/byte limits.

tests.name: reader-safety bounds aggregate source and shared evidence bytes and counts
reader-safety cancels timed-out aborted and failed children without admitted bytes
reader-safety rejects truncated or oversized stdout and stderr without leaks

tasks.title: Bind every distributed output to reviewed provenance
tasks.summary: Add proposed sources/lineage.ts, fixed sources/lineage.json schema v1 and source-to-output closure validation.
acceptanceChecks: Each output path+digest binds full contributing source ID union and reviewer/transformation/modification records; imported copies equal upstream digest, derived bytes use independently checked output digests.

Record sourceRefs/modificationNotes agree with bindings; original/inferred content requires explicit author/rationale declarations; metadata/evidence explicitly categorized; an original record label cannot hide unbound third-party specimens.

Missing contributors, unbound outputs, stale bytes, unresolved references, conflicting declarations and path collisions fail; deterministic lineage bytes are in manifest.files with no candidate/final digest embedded.

tests.name: lineage-closure retains every source and transformation for derived outputs
lineage-closure rejects unbound specimens inconsistent provenance and stale outputs
lineage-closure requires explicit original and inferred output declarations

tasks.title: Generate complete deterministic notices and evidence inventory
tasks.summary: Add proposed sources/notices.ts producing source manifest, NOTICE and unchanged license/notice evidence bytes from eligible closure and lineage.
acceptanceChecks: Preserve exact repository/revision/path/digest, license IDs, all attributions and modifications; license/notice refs resolve to immutable packaged evidence, never remote or absolute paths.
Stable code-unit ordering by sourceId/path; deduplicate identical evidence by raw SHA256 while retaining every association; strict bounded evidence text decode, never decode binary assets as text.

Include only admitted source/evidence entries in SourceManifest; keep rejected ImportReport outside distributed bytes; deterministic output independent of locale, input order, machine path and current time; expected fixture bytes authored independently.

tests.name: notice-closure preserves exact evidence bytes and all source obligations
notice-closure deduplicates shared evidence without losing attribution
notice-closure produces stable expected bytes and rejects invalid evidence text

tasks.title: Compose staging and independently validate candidate eligibility
tasks.summary: Add pure sources/assessment.ts and separate sources/stage.ts I/O orchestration; sources/index.ts exports only pure modules, consuming sc1/sc2 unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Stage source/output bytes then source manifest/lineage/notices; caller declares coverage path/mediaType placeholder before candidate hash; compute eligibility before S003 coverage is finalized.

Independently reconstruct expected metadata, obligations and evidence closure from reviewed inputs; compare candidate bytes and inventory, not caller pass flags or generator invocation; missing contributor, altered metadata/evidence/output or swapped role paths withhold passing assessment.

Emit stage=eligibility bound to nonempty candidateContentDigest only; zero/duplicate coverage membership returns ValidationResult failure, not malformed assessment; no catalog install, publication, coverage algorithm, MCP/IPC or guideline workflow.

tests.name: eligibility-binding reconstructs obligations and rejects modified candidate metadata
eligibility-binding rejects role swaps stale profiles and changed output evidence
acyclic-staging assesses before coverage finalization and rejects missing or duplicate coverage

tasks.title: Prove acceptance and pure boundaries; document maintainer handoff
tasks.summary: Add proposed sources/__tests__/acceptance.test.ts and isolation.test.ts, reuse S001 fixtures without changing their semantics; document reviewed-profile/staging sequence and limitations in corpus README.
acceptanceChecks: Mixed local source end-to-end admits only eligible bytes with exact revisions/attribution/modifications; complete export inventory covers all third-party obligations and S001 preflight accepts using explicitly synthetic S003 coverage fixtures.

Mutation regressions fail for stale profile, source refs, notice omission, lineage/output digest, role swap and noncomputable candidate; original-only and multi-source derived cases pass when complete.

Compile fresh pure corpus/sources entries and run policy/notices/assessment with I/O forbidden; Git entry separate; all corpus tests and strict build pass under supported Node; preserve durable test/build evidence for daemon review.
Document no migration needed for new sc3 module, maintainer-reviewed profiles and future S003/S004 handoff; request independent daemon code review after build and explicit completion approval.
Every preceding task has named tests executed at its own gate; this task adds acceptance and boundary evidence, then runs the accumulated regression suite.
